value.rationale: Meaningful counterexample to a natural stability expectation: strict positivity, full Gaussian localization, real analyticity, unimodality and uniform strong log-concavity fail to ensure redundancy-two Gabor frame stability. The full real interval of explicit theta-calibrated parameters and exact half-integer sampling obstruction distinguish it from sign-changing Hermite examples and random finite tests. The exceptional arithmetic density is singled out by recent frame-set theory; this is structural rather than a superficial tiny gain.
